title: Check if Binary String Has at Most One Segment of Ones
summary: Determine if a binary string, without leading zeros, contains at most one contiguous segment of ones.
statement: Determine if a binary string, without leading zeros, contains at most one contiguous segment of ones. Return true if the condition is met, otherwise return false.
constraints: A segment of ones is a maximal contiguous run of 1 characters.
Return whether the binary string contains at most one such segment.
reference_solution:
def has_at_most_one_one_segment(s):
 return '01' not in s
hints: After a one segment ends, any later one creates a second segment.
Detect whether the string contains a zero-to-one transition.
Return true exactly when substring 01 is absent.
Any 01 transition starts a one segment after zeros; without one, all ones belong to at most the initial single run.
editorial: Any 01 transition starts a one segment after zeros; without one, all ones belong to at most the initial single run.

tests.explanation: The zero-to-one transition starts a second one segment, so return false.
All ones form one initial segment, so return true.
